_what_this_is: hellenic2, built FROM SCRATCH by examples/new_zones/hellenic2/: geometry from SLAB2.0/SLAB1.0 (step 1-2), convergence area-weighted from Bird (2003) (step 3), observed seismicity from a from-scratch GCMT subset (step 4-5). Coupling, b_anchor and mw_max_observed are read from Berryman et al. (2015) directly via berryman_params.py, not from any PTHA18-internal file (see step6_write_input.py's module docstring). This is NOT the official input and will not reproduce PTHA18's published rate curve exactly.
_convergence_provenance: DERIVED in step3_convergence.py: Bird (2003) velocities nearest each column's top edge, area-weighted over the unit sources (lib/bird_convergence.py, PTHA18's method). Horizontal rate: the engine divides it by cos(mean dip) once. This run: 35.7502 mm/yr. The per-column profiles in this block select PTHA18's Bird model for event probabilities and the LEVEL 4 target. Official value not available, run step8_official.py for a comparison.
_observed_seismicity_provenance: DERIVED in step4-5: GCMT catalogue downloaded fresh and filtered by this example's own reimplementation of gcmt_subsetter.R (buffer 0.4 deg, rake and strike within 50 deg of either nodal plane, depth <= 71 km). 0 event(s) above Mw 7.15 in 41.1636 years, window [1976-01-01, 2017-03-01), PTHA18's own window, so the count and the duration compare directly with an official run's. See step5_subset_gcmt.py's module docstring.
_coupling_provenance: DECLARED, not derived: read directly from Berryman et al. (2015) Table 3.1 via berryman_params.py's berryman_coupling('hellenic2'), Berryman's Whole Margin row for the zone where Table 3.1 has one, else the mean across this zone's merged Berryman segments; NOT from PTHA18's own sourcezone_parameters.csv. See berryman_params.py's module docstring for the exact citation, table values and averaging rule, and for why coupling cannot be derived from geometry or a catalogue at all.
_b_anchor_provenance: DECLARED, not derived: bmin/bpref/bmax = [0.69, 0.95, 1.2], read directly from Berryman et al. (2015) Table 3.1 via berryman_params.py's berryman_b_anchor('hellenic2'): the mean across this zone's merged Berryman segments.
_mw_max_observed_provenance: DERIVED: the larger of Berryman et al. (2015)'s largest Mmax-min for the zone (8, berryman_mw_max_observed) and the largest magnitude in step 5's GCMT subset (no event): the largest earthquake known on the zone (ReportPTHA Section 3.7.2.1).
